data.name: Phantom Museum
data.detailed_description:
This is an atmospheric psychological horror experience,
focused on unease, tension, and immersion — not a jump-scare–heavy game.

You explore, observe, and survive within a cursed museum where fear grows slowly,
through space, sound, and the unknown.

Unsettling Creatures from Eastern and Occult Lore

Step into a world shaped by Eastern horror and dark mythology.
Relentless undead inspired by traditional Eastern legends will pursue you without mercy once they sense your presence.
Prefer more familiar nightmares? Beware of gargoyles with razor-sharp teeth, voodoo spirits, demons, ghosts, mummies, and other sinister entities lurking in the halls.

Each creature is carefully designed with distinct behaviors and visual identities,
not to shock you instantly, but to apply constant psychological pressure as you navigate the museum.

Death Is Not the End — It Is a State

In this world, death does not mean failure.
When your body perishes, your soul remains.

As a disembodied spirit, you will wander the haunted museum in search of a new vessel.
Possess statues, ancient artifacts, or even other beings to continue exploring and solving puzzles.

Death becomes part of the gameplay,
allowing you to see, reach, and understand things that the living cannot.

Secrets That Reveal Themselves Only After Death

Beyond the main storyline, the museum hides layers of secrets and forgotten legends.
Certain paths, clues, and hidden narratives only appear once you have been freed from your physical form.

Some truths cannot be reached through survival alone.
In this museum, death may be the only way forward.

A Museum That Never Truly Sleeps

Explore a richly detailed private museum filled with artifacts, relics, and mystical objects drawn from different cultures and eras.
The exhibits are meticulously crafted, inviting close observation even as danger stalks nearby.

Between moments of pursuit and escape, you can pause to examine displays,
read real-world books scattered throughout the halls, and piece together the history behind the curse.

This is not just a haunted house —
it is a slow-burning, immersive exploration through history, myth, and dread.

Enter the Museum

Possess. Escape. Observe. Uncover hidden truths.

Survive the cursed halls of the museum —
or remain within them forever.

Will you break the curse…
or become part of the collection?

data.short_description: This is an atmospheric psychological horror experience, focused on unease and immersion — not a jump-scare–heavy game. As you explore finely crafted museum exhibits, you must rip away talismans sealing dangerous spirits, solve eerie puzzles, evade grotesque creatures, and search for a way out.

English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*
